notes: User is planning a future solo trip to Tokyo and is excited to explore it. They recently took a family trip to Paris, which they loved and where their children seemed to enjoy themselves. They are considering Tokyo partly because it would feel very different from Paris, and want unique/off-the-beaten-path experiences rather than only major tourist attractions. Interests include Japanese food (especially sushi and local specialties), culture, tea ceremonies, digital art, gardens, quirky cafés/vending machines, nightlife, museums, sumo, coastal/day-trip scenery, and meeting people while traveling solo. They value the freedom, spontaneity, and personal growth possible on solo trips but recognize challenges such as loneliness, planning, and safety. Their accommodation budget is approximately $30–50 per night, and they are concerned that Tokyo is expensive. They are especially interested in affordable hostels, guesthouses, capsule hotels, and shared accommodation, ideally in convenient areas such as Shinjuku, Shibuya, Ikebukuro, Asakusa, or central Tokyo. The user has not yet specified travel dates, length of stay, or exact travel style beyond budget.

User has not yet stated a destination beyond considering Japan.
